body:
That seemed to fix the specific issue on the homepage. However the url params are intermittently disappearing and filters dropping. It generally happens on category pages when using the back button from a detail page. So on category page, apply filter, click item, press back button, url params disappear, filters reset. Doesnt happen every time.

I've recorded a video showing it happen. https://www.loom.com/share/c1aff09db1e64072b4c64d772923d409?sid=2668e757-fb05-46d6-a38d-2c1359dc47d2
